sections.content: HSI is a leading manufacturing company. We are committed to excellence, innovation, and the highest quality standards. We are looking for experienced ASME Code Welders to join our dynamic team, someone who shares our passion for delivering top-notch services that exceed expectations.

sections.heading: Job Information:
sections.content: We are looking for experienced ASME Code Welders (X-ray quality) for full-time employment to perform high-quality welding work in accordance with ASME codes and standards. The successful candidate will be responsible for welding various materials, including carbon steel, stainless steel, and any other alloys, in all positions to meet the project specifications and industry standards. This position is vital in ensuring the structural integrity and safety of our projects. Must be able to pass an ASME code-compliant welding test (3g flux core). Mig and Stick welding experience is a plus. Pay is based on skill, performance, and shift worked.

sections.heading: $2,000 sign-on bonus for qualified candidates, subject to eligibility requirements and company policy.
Candidate Requirements:
sections.content:
Candidate should have at least 3 years of previous ASME Code welding experience.
Proficiency in various welding techniques, including Flux-Core.
Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and welding procedures.
Perform welding operations in compliance with ASME codes and standards.
Conduct visual inspections of welds to ensure quality and compliance.
Maintain a clean and safe work environment.
Always adhere to safety protocols and guidelines.

sections.heading: What We Offer:
sections.content:
Competitive Salary
Production bonus - based on attendance and safety record
Health, Dental and Vision Insurance available for employee and your family
401(k) Savings Plan
Paid Holidays & Vacations
All employees are expected to be drug free and must pass a drug test before employment begins.
